planSlice: 7M CLI publication behavior for pre-AC1032 embedded ATTRIB MTEXT
scope: Verify that the real dwg2dxf CLI refuses an R2018 embedded ATTRIB MTEXT when targeting AC1027 without publishing or replacing output, while ordinary ATTRIB conversion remains available.

behavior: The test creates its AC1032 ASCII DXF source locally in a temporary directory; no drawing fixture is checked in.
AC1027 conversion of the embedded-MTEXT ATTRIB fails through positional and FreeCAD-compatible -o command forms for ASCII and Binary DXF output.
Absent output stays absent; seeded output is preserved byte-for-byte; transaction side files are not retained.
Removing embedded MTEXT allows ordinary ATTRIB output in both encodings and both command forms.
implementation.cliReasonVisibility: The CLI exposes a generic DXF export failure; the writer's reason-specific leftOut() message is not surfaced by this route.

validation.gitCommitLimitation: Git metadata is read-only in this environment; the shared worktree is broadly modified.
